outlets.name: MICHELIN Guide Florida (Orlando selection)
outlets.credible: The MICHELIN Guide's Florida selection (since 2022) covers Orlando — stars, Bib Gourmands and Recommended; an institutional authority that is ground truth on its own.

outlets.name: James Beard Foundation Awards
outlets.credible: National culinary awards of record (winners, finalists, semifinalists, America's Classics); institutional authority.

outlets.name: Orlando Sentinel (food, dining & theme-park desks)
outlets.credible: Central Florida's daily paper of record since 1876; bylined restaurant critics and a dedicated theme-park reporter (Dewayne Bevil).

outlets.name: Orlando Weekly
outlets.credible: Orlando's alt-weekly since 1990; bylined food critics (Faiyaz Kara) and the annual reader-voted Best of Orlando awards.

outlets.name: Orlando Magazine (Dining Awards / Best of)
outlets.credible: The metro's city magazine since 1946; annual Dining Awards and Best of Orlando from critics and readers.

outlets.name: Eater (national + Eater Florida coverage)
outlets.credible: Vox Media's national food site; bylined Orlando maps and heatmaps.

outlets.name: WMFE 90.7 (Central Florida Public Media, NPR)
outlets.credible: Central Florida's NPR member station; reported features on local food, culture, springs and space.

outlets.name: Visit Orlando (official destination marketing org)
outlets.credible: Orlando's official tourism bureau; destination listings and press releases (counts as one editorial voice, never alone).

outlets.name: Tasty Chomps (Ricky Ly)
outlets.credible: Long-running Orlando food blog (since 2010) by Ricky Ly; a Michelin-ceremony and local-dining news source of record in the Orlando food community, frequently cited by local TV.

outlets.name: NASA / Kennedy Space Center
outlets.credible: Federal space agency; authority on Kennedy Space Center facilities and history.

outlets.name: National Park Service
outlets.credible: Federal agency; operates Canaveral National Seashore — institutional authority for the sites it runs.

outlets.name: Florida State Parks (FL DEP)
outlets.credible: Official state park system; authority on Wekiwa Springs, Blue Spring, Rock Springs and other state parks.

outlets.name: Wikipedia
outlets.credible: Notability + published coordinates for landmarks and park attractions; one corroborating voice, never alone.

outlets.name: Official site (venue / Walt Disney World / Universal Orlando)
outlets.credible: The place's own site — authority on its own address/hours; counts ONCE toward the two-source bar, never alone.

outlets.name: Atlas Obscura
outlets.credible: Curated oddities catalogue with editorial review.

outlets.name: Theme Park Insider (Robert Niles)
outlets.credible: Award-winning independent theme-park news site since 1999 (Robert Niles, former LA Times); reader-rated attraction rankings.

outlets.name: Disney Food Blog (AJ Wolfe)
outlets.credible: The largest Disney dining outlet (since 2008; ~1M+ social followers, YouTube channel ~700k); reviews of named park dishes — a verifiably popular creator outlet, one corroborating voice.

outlets.name: Inside the Magic
outlets.credible: Long-running theme-park news site (since 2005) with a large social following; corroborating only.

outlets.name: WFTV Channel 9 (ABC Orlando)
outlets.credible: Orlando ABC affiliate; reported local news including restaurant openings/closures and Michelin coverage.

outlets.name: News 6 WKMG (ClickOrlando)
outlets.credible: Orlando CBS/independent station; reported local news and food features.

outlets.name: Spectrum News 13
outlets.credible: Central Florida 24-hour local news channel.

outlets.name: WESH 2 (NBC Orlando)
outlets.credible: Orlando NBC affiliate; reported local news.
